hypotheses.justification: The definition of AutomorphicForm.sigmaTensor requires only [Field K], [Field L], [Algebra K L], and a commutative K-algebra A. The local sigmaTensor_pow lemma has the same requirements. Taking A = Kv uses [NumberField K], not [NumberField L], so the existing rewrite proof works unchanged after omitting [NumberField L]. This is multiplicativity of an iterated ring homomorphism, valid for every i, including i = 0, and all x and y, including zero.
